title: Work retained filters: validate hidden-window geometry and remaining lifecycle coverage
outcome: Follow up three non-blocking R1 Low groups after the retained-filter fix lands: verify and address hidden-width ResizeObserver measurement retention for long lists, strengthen hidden-scroll/view-remount/filter-focus witnesses, and cover all source-key fields plus display-state reset. Preserve local-only filtering and serial read ownership. This is optional follow-up inventory with no executing assignee; Fable2 owns later prioritization after parent landing.
acceptance: A deterministic measurement witness and supported real-browser observation with more than 60 rows establish whether a Memories round trip drops cached heights or changes the viewed rows; any confirmed defect is fixed without causing work-list reads.

Scroll coverage distinguishes hidden scroll events, a measured Table-to-Hierarchy remount and Search/Apply control focus. Removing the corresponding production guard makes each new witness fail for its stated behavior.

Source-generation tests distinguish changes to remoteId, engramDeclared and engramOperatorDisabled and verify that a source replacement resets local filters, label selection, sort, view and Memories state while unrelated updates retain the read.
